record.dic_text:
01592 G@nubath {ge-nu-vat'}

源自 01589; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Genubath 2; 2

基努拔 = "盜竊"
1) 以東王室的哈達和埃及公主 (答比匿的妹妹) 所生的兒子,
   答比匿是在大衛王後期統治埃及的女王 (#王上 11:20|)
record.edic_text:
01592 G@nubath {ghen-oo-bath'}

from 01589;; n pr m

AV - Genubath 2; 2

Genubath = "theft"
1) son of Hadad, an Edomite of the royal family, by an Egyptian
   princess, the sister of Tahpenes, the queen of the Pharaoh who
   governed Egypt in the latter part of the reign of David
